sections.heading: MINOR IN COMMUNICATING CULTURES
lines: Completion of first-year requirements with no failures and no mark less than 60% in 3.0 principal courses, which must include 2.0 from: English 1027F/G, English 1028F/G, or English 1035E, or English 1036E; GSI 1021F/G; Philosophy 1370A/B; Chinese 1650F/G; Japanese 1650F/G; Writing 1025F/G; History 1801E; Interdisciplinary Studies 1021E; Political Science 1020E.
1.0 course from: Interdisciplinary Studies 2220F/G, Interdisciplinary Studies 2230F/G.
1.0 course from: English 2200F/G, English 2235A/B, English 2236F/G, GSI 2003F/G, GSI 3005F/G, the former English 2220F/G.
1.0 course from: Writing 2101F/G, Writing 2208F/G, Speech 2001, English 2011A/B, English 2012A/B, Chinese 2240F/G, Chinese 2241F/G, French 3206A/B.

1.0 course from: History 2701E, History 2706E, Political Science 2222E, Political Science 3385F/G, GSI 4017F/G, Religious Studies 2620F/G, Theological Studies 3210F/G, French 3752F/G, English 2361E, English 2362F/G, English 2363F/G, English 3884E, the former GSI 3511F/G.
Note: No course may be credited toward another module. Please note prerequisites for senior courses.
